character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Transform the uploaded barbarian character into a 2D fantasy MMORPG game sprite with a three-quarter diagonal perspective.

Preserve the exact character identity: black hair, face, muscular body, clothing colors and overall design.

Change only the viewing angle and body orientation.

The character should be standing with his body slightly turned diagonally, showing both the front and one side of his body. His face should be looking slightly toward the viewer's lower-right direction.

Inspired by classic isometric 2D MMORPG character sprites.

Keep the same pixel art aesthetic, proportions, color palette and level of detail as the original.

Full body, feet visible, neutral standing pose, transparent background.

Single character only. No environment, no shadows, no text, no additional characters.

Do not create a top-down view. Do not make the character face directly toward the camera. Do not redesign his appearance.
